$comment: Allowlist for check-nav-coverage.mjs (file→nav coverage auditor). List repo-relative file paths (e.g. "guides/legacy.mdx") OR their page slugs (e.g. "guides/legacy") for customer-facing .mdx/.md pages that are INTENTIONALLY absent from docs.json navigation and are therefore acceptably unsearchable (docs.json sets seo.indexing='navigable'). This is only for residual exceptions the script's structural rules do not already cover — the script already excludes internal dirs (app_docs/, specs/, images/, logo/, scripts/, snippets/, lib/, node_modules, .git, .github), non-default locale trees (fr/, es/ — derived from docs.json navigation.languages), underscore-prefixed files/dirs (design/draft docs), and repo-root meta files (AGENTS.md, SECURITY.md, README*). NEVER allowlist a genuine customer page to silence the gate — navigate it instead. As of the auditor's introduction the structural rules leave 0 orphans, so this list is empty.
